sections.heading: Angus Young — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Angus Young was born on 31 March 1955 in Glasgow, and holds Australian and British nationality. He was given the name Angus McKinnon Young at birth and is publicly known as Angus Young.

He received his education at Ashfield Boys' High School.
